title: centaurium umbellatum var. broteri
intro: Centaurium umbellatum var. broteri, commonly known as Broteri's centaury, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Gentianaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, improve respiratory function, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Broteri's centaury include gentiopicroside, loganic acid, and other iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
